user.title: CTHA - Chronothermostat
user.description: Pick the temperature sensor and the actuator to control.

abort.already_configured: A zone already exists for this actuator.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Force a temperature on a zone, bypassing the schedule.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature to hold while the override is valid.

policy.name: Expiry
policy.description: When the override lapses: end of the current slot, fixed duration, scenario change, or never.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Override duration, used only with the fixed-duration expiry.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Remove a zone's override and return it to the schedule.

set_day_template.name: Set day template
set_day_template.description: Create a day template, or update its name and slots. Omitted fields are left untouched.

template_id.name: Identifier
template_id.description: Day template id: it is created if it does not exist.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: 48 characters, one every 30 minutes from midnight: c = comfort, e = eco, a = antifreeze, - = inherit from global.

paint_slots.name: Paint slots
paint_slots.description: Assign a level to a range of slots in a day template, both ends included.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to edit.

start_slot.name: First slot
start_slot.description: First slot to paint: 0 is midnight, 47 is 23:30.

end_slot.name: Last slot
end_slot.description: Last slot to paint, included. If omitted only the first slot is painted.

level.name: Level
level.description: Level to assign. If omitted the slots go back to inheriting from global.

duplicate_day_template.name: Duplicate day template
duplicate_day_template.description: Copy a day template and, on request, point the given days at the copy: this is how a single day is differentiated without changing the template for everyone using it.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to copy.

new_id.name: Copy id
new_id.description: Id for the copy. One is generated if omitted.

name.name: Copy name
name.description: Name for the copy. Defaults to the original's name with "(copia)" appended.

week_template.name: Week template
week_template.description: Week template whose days should be pointed at the copy. If omitted the copy is left unlinked.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to re-point, with 0 = Monday. If omitted, every day of that week using the original is moved.

delete_day_template.name: Delete day template
delete_day_template.description: Delete a day template. Fails if a week template is still using it.

template_id.name: Day template
template_id.description: Id of the day template to delete.

set_week_template.name: Set week template
set_week_template.description: Create a week template, or update its name and day assignments. The given days are merged into the existing ones.

template_id.name: Identifier
template_id.description: Week template id: it is created if it does not exist.

days.name: Days
days.description: Map of day → day template, with 0 = Monday. An empty value leaves the day unassigned.

delete_week_template.name: Delete week template
delete_week_template.description: Delete a week template. Fails if a scenario or a zone is still following it.

template_id.name: Week template
template_id.description: Id of the week template to delete.

set_scenario.name: Set scenario
set_scenario.description: Create a scenario, or update its name, week template and thermal offsets.

scenario_id.name: Identifier
scenario_id.description: Scenario id: it is created if it does not exist.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Shift applied to every temperature of the scenario.

zone_offsets.name: Per-zone offsets
zone_offsets.description: Map of zone → offset, for the zones that differ. An empty value removes the exception.

delete_scenario.name: Delete scenario
delete_scenario.description: Delete a scenario. Neither the active one nor the last remaining one can be deleted.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Id of the scenario to delete.

activate_scenario.name: Activate scenario
activate_scenario.description: Make a scenario active; overrides tied to the previous one lapse.

scenario_id.name: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Id of the scenario to activate.

set_setpoint.name: Set setpoint
set_setpoint.description: Set the temperature of a level, globally or for a single zone.

level.name: Level
level.description: Level to set: comfort, eco or antifreeze.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature for the level. Leaving it empty makes the zone inherit from the global setpoint again; the global setpoint cannot be empty.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: Zone to edit. If omitted the global setpoint is changed.

set_zone_week_template.name: Zone schedule
set_zone_week_template.description: Give a zone a week template of its own, or send it back to following the scenario's one.

template_id.name: Week template
template_id.description: Week template to assign to the zone. If omitted the zone goes back to following the scenario.
